According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple is preparing for the launch of its Home product line and will make significant changes to its physical retail stores. Apple is expected to announce updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K as early as this fall, and the related changes seem to hint that a third, more important product will debut simultaneously.

Apple has accumulated a large number of unreleased Home products, mainly because the Siri revamp project has been delayed repeatedly. With the Siri redesign finally complete, you can expect some products to finally meet the public after years without updates.

However, earlier reports had indicated that Apple would first release updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K, while the company's first smart home hub (i.e., a HomePod or HomePad with a built-in screen) might not arrive until later.

However, based on the current retail store preparations, this smart home hub may launch simultaneously with the updated Apple TV and HomePod mini. The above content comes from the Power On newsletter.

Of course, the final answer will have to wait until Apple's September launch event. However, according to today's report, Apple's brand-new smart home hub has a high chance of debuting alongside the updated Apple TV 4K with Siri AI support and the HomePod mini.

Quick Overview

In summary, Apple's smart home hub is widely rumoured to feature a 7-inch square display and come in two versions: one with a built-in speaker, and another with magnets on the back for wall mounting. This product will run an entirely new operating system, with the home screen supporting widgets. In addition to supporting FaceTime video calls, it will also serve as the central hub for all smart home accessories and Siri, and will come with an A18 chip built in.

Another rumour about the Home product line is that the next-generation Apple TV 4K may come with an updated Siri Remote, though the specific changes are still unclear for now.

Are you interested in the new Home products? Which one are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
